packageRules.description: Nightly: everything the builder does not load (frontend, root dev deps, Actions, Docker, tool pins), none of which changes the built catalog bytes. No minimum release age anywhere (repo policy, mirrors uv `exclude-newer = false` and bunfig `minimumReleaseAge = 0`); this also lifts config:recommended's npm delay.
Move pyproject floors to the newest release and relock (repo convention), not lock-only.
Weekly: what the builder loads. reg_meta_build's and reg-core-py's declared deps and every Cargo manifest (reg-core-py is built from crates/).
prBodyNotes: Merges on green CI; the next curation real-seed build proves it (no standalone proof build).

packageRules.description: The Python interpreter (.python-version, requires-python) moves with the docs: a manual upgrade (upgrade-deps), not a one-file bump.

Frontend toolchain that must move in step: React and its types, React Aria Components (it pins react-aria/react-stately internally) and the locale plugin built for it, and the Vite, plugin-react and Vitest trio (plugin-react and Vitest each peer on a Vite major).
